actions.desc: The ammut attempts to absorb the spirit of a dead or undead creature in its belly. The creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be absorbed by the ammut. A creature absorbed this way is destroyed and can't be reanimated, though it can be restored to life by powerful magic, such as a resurrection spell. The ammut regains hp equal to the absorbed creature's hp maximum.

actions.name: Absorb Spirit

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the ammut can't bite another target.

actions.name: Bite

actions.desc: The ammut inhales the tortured spirits of undead within 30 feet. Each undead creature of CR 1 and lower in the area is automatically destroyed. All other undead must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
actions.desc_ru: Действие «Призрак Бреат»; тип: action. Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
actions.name: Ghost Breath

actions.desc:
The ammut makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained and it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the ammut. An ammut can only have one Medium or smaller creature swallowed at a time.

If the ammut takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the ammut must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the ammut. If the ammut dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.
actions.desc_ru: Действие «Сваллов»; тип: action. Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
actions.name: Swallow

traits.desc: An undead creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the ammut must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the ammut's Judging Aura for the next 24 hours.
traits.desc_ru: Особенность «Джудгинг Аура». Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
traits.name: Judging Aura

traits.desc: The ammut has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
traits.desc_ru: Совершает спасброски от заклинаний и прочих магических эффектов с преимуществом.
traits.name: Magic Resistance

traits.desc: The large belly of the ammut magically sustains the life of those trapped inside it. A creature caught in its belly doesn't need food, water, or air. The ammut can maintain one Medium or smaller creature this way as long as the ammut remains alive.
traits.desc_ru: Особенность «Присон Беллй». Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
traits.name: Prison Belly

ru.description: Крупный небожитель, мировоззрение: нейтральное. Класс доспеха: 17 (природный доспех). Хиты: 172 (15к10+90). Скорость: ходьба 30 фт.. Характеристики: СИЛ 20, ЛОВ 12, ТЕЛ 23, ИНТ 6, МУД 16, ХАР 12. Сопротивление урону: холодом, излучением. Иммунитет к урону: некротической энергией. Иммунитет к состояниям: испуг. Чувства: тёмное зрение 120 фт., пассивное Восприятие 21. Показатель опасности: 9. Структурированные механики записи: особенностей: 3, действий: 4.
ru.name: Аммут
